title: Roadmap to Kamailio v4.3.0
html:
The next major release of Kamailio is going to be version 4.3.0.

The plan to release it was sketched during the last IRC devel meeting. The current proposal is to publish the new version by the beginning of June 2015. Given there has to be at least one month of testing, these are our milestones:

  • Freezing the development: Wednesday, April 22, 2015
    After this, only bug fixing will happen in the development branch.
  • The week starting May 18th: If testing goes smooth, then the 4.3 branch in our GIT platform will be created
    At this point, new features can be added to the development branch again.
  • Test more in beta phase, prepare packaging, etc. and release after 2-3 weeks: One of the days between June 4 and 11

Other suggestions or adjustments are welcome! Send them to mailing list for further discussions!
